title: Redridge Canyons

[[File:Redridge Canyons.jpg|thumb|300px|Redridge Canyons]]

The '''Redridge Canyons''' are a subzone in the northwestern part of the [[Redridge Mountains]]. The area is home to the [[Yowler's Den|den]] of [[Yowler]], leader of the [[Redridge pack|local gnolls]].
